Situation Brief — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

  • Air campaign / airports: US/Israeli strikes on Iran continue over the campaign. Regional airports remain closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah activity continues daily. Expect rocket/missile harassment and cross-border fire. No mass ground invasion reported in last 6 hours.
  • Gaza / Hamas: IDF and Shin Bet report they killed a Hamas terrorist who abducted Capt. Daniel Perez and held hostages. Tactical win for hostage recovery operations.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran says it will allow passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) and block others. Iran-Oman arrangements cited; adds selective maritime pressure on global trade.
  • Regional & international moves: Pakistan mediating. Russia moving V-200 helicopters/drones to Far East (longer-term force posture). Oil prices reported stable for now.
  • Domestic politics: Israel approved plan for 13 new West Bank settlements. Political friction could complicate diplomatic options.
  • Good to monitor: Iran warns against strikes during Khamenei funeral week. Mass funeral events under way in Tehran.
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause announced; IDF/Shin Bet neutralized a Hamas captor who held Israeli hostages; oil prices stable.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

Situation Report — Day 27

Active strikes/sirens:
  • Ongoing: US/Israeli airstrikes on targets inside Iran. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas continue missile/rocket/predicted drone strikes on Israel. Northern border with Lebanon active daily.

Diplomacy / Pause

  • Trump announced SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes: 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET. He says talks "going very well."
  • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Tactical context: first 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

Military / Kinetics

  • IDF/US continue precision strikes inside Iran. Iran and proxies continue counter‑strikes on Israeli territory and facilities.
  • Northern border: daily Hezbollah launches and IDF responses. Persistent low‑to‑medium intensity exchanges.
  • Iran warned against strikes during Supreme Leader funeral week; security posture heightened in Tehran.

Maritime & Logistics

  • Iran allows Strait of Hormuz passage only for select states (Russia, India, China). Others face restrictions.
  • Airspace: multiple regional airports reported closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan).

International

  • Pakistan actively mediating. Russia/China/India retain maritime access through Hormuz — reduces immediate global oil shock risk but keeps strategic frictions.

Good News

  • IDF reports it killed a Hamas operative who abducted tank officer Daniel Perez and held hostages.
  • Temporary pause declaration may create a window for diplomacy if respected.
Threat assessment: Volatile — de‑escalation possible but high risk of renewed wide escalation if pauses are violated.

  • איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווכת. הקשר הטקטי: ההפסקה הראשונה (5 ימים, 23 במארס) הופרה כשש שעות אחריה הותקפו אספהאן וח'ורמסהאר.

  • תקיפות מדויקות של ישראל/ארה"ב בתוך איראן נמשכות. תגובות טילים מרובות על שטח ישראל וייעדי תשתית.

מימי ולוגיסטיקה

  • איראן מאפשרת מעבר במצר הורמוז רק למדינות נבחרות (רוסיה, הודו, סין). שאר המדינות מוגבלות.
